race.comment: JACKS ON ICE (2) strode forward as he likes to do here last start and proved too strong. He's a track and trip specialist and from the wide draw they should replicate those tactics. Keeps the important 3kg claim and can repeat the dose. FLOREY (12) returns and is a noted fresh performer. She has the peaks to be right there at the business end and gets a key booking in Toeroek to manage the tricky draw. Can make a winning return. FLYING BRANT (8) resumes and while this looks short of his preferred trip, he needs to kick off somewhere and hasn't found the deepest of races to do so. Showed promising signs in his debut prep and the stable clearly has an opinion of him. Not taking lightly. CHIPSON (10) has caught the eye in his two runs back and should be hitting his straps now. CHAKADO (3) is another handy fresh runner and is drawn to get all the favours. Two hitouts in readiness should have him forward enough to play a role.
